commentary: Today, DCE iron ore futures conƟnued to hold up well, with the most-traded contract I2509 touching 708 before weakening slightly and closing at 709, up 0.93% for the day. Traders showed a good willingness to sell. Steel mills largely completed their weekly procurement, with only some purchasing as needed today. The market transacƟon atmosphere was average. In the Shandong region, the mainstream transacƟon prices of PB ﬁnes were around 710-715 yuan/mt, up 0-5 yuan/mt from yesterday. In the Tangshan region, the transacƟon prices of PB ﬁnes were around 720-723 yuan/mt, up 0-3 yuan/mt from yesterday. From the SMM35 port inventory data, this week, inﬂuenced by weather condiƟons, port arrivals declined slightly. However, downstream demand improved MoM, with steel mills showing increased enthusiasm for producƟon and procurement, driving a slight increase in port pick- up volume. As a result, port inventory maintained destocking, providing some support to ore prices.
